Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pallavi - 36 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sanjay - 44 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Pallavi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Ayaan: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Ayaan stands on the road. Pallavi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Sanjay, look over here."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ayaan sits in the back seat.]

Sanjay: "That's easy."

[Ayaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Sanjay: "Okay, Pallavi."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ayaan in the back.]

Pallavi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
